title: Identifying Even Numbers
goal: Complete the condition so that the program counts the even numbers in the list.

support_messages.1: What property of a number shows whether it can be divided by 2 with no remainder?
support_messages.2: In Python, the % operator returns the remainder after division. Think about the remainder when an even number is divided by 2.
support_messages.3: An even number leaves a remainder of zero when divided by 2. Try building a condition with n % 2.
support_messages.4: The condition is n % 2 == 0. It checks whether the remainder after dividing a number by 2 is zero.

title: Applying the Same Principle
goal: Complete the condition so that only odd numbers are added to result.

support_messages.1: What can you say about the remainder when an odd number is divided by 2?
support_messages.2: Use the % operator. An odd number leaves a remainder other than zero when divided by 2.
support_messages.3: First find n % 2, then check that this remainder is not zero.
support_messages.4: The condition is n % 2 != 0. It selects numbers with a non-zero remainder after division by 2.

title: Independent Check
goal: What value will the program print?

support_messages.1: Check each number in the list in turn: how many of them leave a remainder of zero when divided by 2?
support_messages.2: Start with count = 0 and inspect the list one number at a time. Each time the condition is true, the counter increases by 1.
support_messages.3: Write down the matching numbers separately: the condition checks for a remainder of zero after division by 2. Count them, remembering that count starts at zero.
support_messages.4: The matching numbers are 4, 12, and 20. There are three of them, so count becomes 3 and the program prints 3.
